log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill only the national criminal plus both web criminals, all as quick entries in the afternoon. Worst case if L traces timing and web: afternoon-free routines (students, night workers, home) = 55%, times web 30% = 16.5%, about 1.65M. Police trimming of up to 5% per conference could bring that to about 1M by day 30, which is still safe. Do NOT add a second source: two sources plus timing is about 0.05 x 10M, roughly 500k, which trimming could push under 300k. If a press conference warns of new records, stay with web only. If announced pools drop near 1M or below, cut back to national only. Day 1: killed d1-national-1, d1-web-1 and d1-web-2 in the afternoon.

STRATEGY (revised day 2): Kill 4 a day: national-1, web-1, web-2 and court-1. Make web-1 and web-2 quick entries in the afternoon. Make national-1 and court-1 timed entries in the evening. Why this works: every routine is then busy during at most 2 of the day's deaths. Day workers are busy for the 2 afternoon deaths and night workers for the 2 evening deaths, so timing rules out nobody. Worst case (L traces web and court) is a pool of 30% x 20% = 6%, about 600k. Trimming of 5% per conference brings that to about 360k by day 30, which is still safe. RULES: (1) Never use more than 2 quick entries a day, because 3 afternoon deaths would rule out day workers. (2) Never put more than 2 deaths in the evening or night. (3) Never add a third source. (4) If a press conference warns of new records, or announced pools fall to 1M or below, drop court and keep national plus web only, still split as 2 quick afternoon and 1 timed evening. Day 1: national and 2 web, all quick afternoon. Day 2: web x2 quick afternoon, national and court timed evening.

STRATEGY (revised day 3): Day 1 broke the rule. It had 3 quick afternoon deaths, so if L has timing he has already ruled out day workers. The timing factor is then 0.55, not 1. Worst case with web, court and timing: 10M x 0.55 x 0.3 x 0.2 = 330k, and trimming would push that below 300k. So court is dropped permanently from day 3. Worst case now (timing and web): 10M x 0.55 x 0.3 = 1.65M, or about 1.0M after full trimming, which is safe. DAILY PLAN: national-1 timed evening, web-1 and web-2 quick afternoon. That is 3 kills a day. RULES: (1) Kill only national and web. Never add regional, court, foreign, medical or union. (2) At most 2 afternoon deaths a day, to protect the day-worker count if L only gains timing later. (3) At most 2 evening or night deaths a day. (4) Never kill in the morning or night blocks in a way that busies students or home people. Students are busy morning and night, so avoid deaths in those blocks. (5) If a conference warns of new records, or the announced pool is 300k or less, consider dropping web and killing national only (timed evening). History: day 1 was national and 2 web, quick afternoon. Day 2 was 2 web quick afternoon, plus national and court timed evening. Day 3 is 2 web quick afternoon plus national timed evening.

STRATEGY (revised day 4): Correction to the old plan. Court was already exposed by the day 2 court kill. If L can trace court, he already has that fact, so more court kills add no new risk. Day workers are also already ruled out by day 1 if L ever gets timing, since timing applies to past deaths too. So extra afternoon deaths cost nothing more. Worst case already locked in (timing, web and court): 10M x 0.55 x 0.3 x 0.2 = 330k, and trimming could push it below 300k. Nothing can undo that, so maximise points within the existing exposure. DAILY PLAN: kill national, web-1, web-2, court-1 and court-2, all quick afternoon. That is 5 a day. Afternoon deaths make only day workers busy, and they are already out. Students, home people and night workers are all free in the afternoon. No timed entries are needed. RULES: (1) Kill only national, web and court. Never add regional, foreign, medical or union, because each would cut the pool by 0.25 to 0.3 more. (2) Never kill in the morning, evening or night, so that students and home people are never busy. (3) If a conference warns of new records, or announces a pool of 300k or less, consider cutting back to national only, quick afternoon.
